title: Farmers Market Vendor Form
subtitle: Farmers Market Vendor Operation: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Farmers Market Vendor Form covers vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout. The market vendor coordinator records Farmers Market Vendor Operation activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Farmers Market Vendor Form keeps Farmers Market Vendor Operation exceptions visible until the market vendor coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Farmers Market Vendor Form at market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area. Document vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout identity before Farmers Market Vendor Operation begins. Compare vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout findings with stated Farmers Market Vendor Operation criteria; route unresolved Farmers Market Vendor Operation issues to market operations or food-safety reviewer. For Farmers Market Vendor Form, confirm requirements for Farmers Market Vendor Operation. Ask market operations or food-safety reviewer to review Farmers Market Vendor Operation conditions beyond the market vendor coordinator's role.

sections.title: Operating context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Farmers Market Vendor Operation, identify responsible parties, market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area, and the linked vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout source.

fields.label: Product, lot, source, quantity, and price
Permit, insurance, contact, and payment identifiers

sections.title: Task lines and operating evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Farmers Market Vendor Operation facts for vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farmers Market Vendor Operation operating checks
items: Label, price, allergen, and customer information
Cash, electronic payment, and sales reconciliation
Unsold product, waste, complaint, and incident closeout

sections.title: Retained evidence and next operating review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Farmers Market Vendor Operation conditions; have market vendor coordinator assign the next Farmers Market Vendor Operation owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Complaint or unsold product lacks disposition
blocks.guidance: Pause Farmers Market Vendor Operation when vendor authority, product trace, display control, complaint, or product disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Farmers Market Vendor Operation proof and route unresolved vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout scope to market vendor coordinator.
